<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Moonseed &middot; Copper coil &middot; Star lantern &middot; Sky bearing &middot; Beacon restored</small></p>


<p align="center">You return to the workshop. The ghost clears a desk. You place the brass key beside a fresh notebook.</p>

<p align="center">The empty chair looks less like a vacancy and more like a beginning.</p>

<p align="center">Outside, the beacon turns toward the trees. Somewhere, someone will notice it.</p>

<p align="center">THE NIGHTKEEPER - The house is no longer waiting for someone to come back. Someone new has chosen to stay.</p>
